job: Show richer content than a list next to its trigger: a summary, a small form, a picker.
purpose: A floating panel built on the native Popover API. It closes on outside click, Escape or when focus leaves. Focus moves in when it opens and back to the trigger on Escape. With head, body and foot parts it becomes flush. data-arrow links it to a small anchor. Sizes sm 280px, default 360px, lg 420px.
useWhen: A trigger opens a summary, a few fields or a picker that does not warrant a dialog.
A usage figure with a note and a link sits behind a small chip.
A filter or a date range opens from a button.

avoidWhen.when: A short list of actions or choices.
The task needs full attention or blocks the page.
Detail of an item picked from a list.

states.name: arrow
states.how: data-arrow adds a pointer to the anchor

variants.useWhen: A panel sized by its content, such as a date range.
